segments.text:
If Jesus Christ be the great Prophet of the Church,
then surely he will take special care both of the Church, and the under shepherds appointed by him to feed them. Else both the objects, and instruments upon, and by which he executes his office, must fail, and consequently this glorious office be in vain. Hence he is said to walk among the golden Candlesticks, Revel. 1.13. and Rev. 2.1. to hold the Stars in his right hand. Jesus Christ instrumentally opens the understandings of men by the preaching of the Gospel; and whilst there is an elect soul to be converted, or a convert to be farther illuminated, means shall not fail to accomplish it by.
